newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BARPROP REPOSITIONS PROPERTY PORTFOLIO.
newsitem.headline: BARPROP REPOSITIONS PROPERTY PORTFOLIO.

text.p: Property company Barprop Ltd said on Wednesday it had disposed of several identified properties for a total of 69.6 million rand during the 1997 financial year.
The group said this was in line with its strategic re-evaluation of portfolio of properties which it announced last year would be repositioned to have a more direct industrial focus.
It said the properties had been disposed to "various buyers" but did not give details.
The group also referred to a recent joint cautionary with RMP Properties Ltd and advised shareholders to continue to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made.
